name: telegram-agent
description: Local Telegram API inbox and reply assistant tools for Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Triage Telegram, build personal briefings, draft issues/replies, and send authorized messages.
interface.longDescription: Telegram Agent adds a local browser setup wizard and Codex tools for inbox briefs, dialog search, selected chat context, SQLite cache search, personal briefings, smart inbox ranking, local memory search, secret-safe sensitive search, contact briefs, maintainer context packs, prompt-injection detection, GitHub issue drafts, reply drafts, and direct sends to explicitly authorized chats through a Telegram API login session. It does not read Telegram Desktop tdata.
defaultPrompt: Set up Telegram Agent in the local browser wizard.
Build my personal Telegram briefing for today.
Search my Telegram memory for a link, address, or code.
Find a chat and summarize what needs my reply.
Draft a reply, but do not send it.
I authorize you to keep messaging one selected chat during this task.
